findings.clauseQuote: The following terms are strictly banned in all customer-facing text: "cheap", "junk", "old clothes", "second-hand" (in captions; permitted only in alt text or hashtags), and "used" as a garment quality descriptor

findings.clauseQuote: Minimum starting prices for standard curated items are: Tees starting from ₹299; Jeans/Denim starting from ₹599; Jackets starting from ₹899; Ethnic sets starting from ₹799. Advertising prices below these thresholds (such as jeans for ₹299) is factually incorrect.
findings.explanation: The caption advertises denim jeans at ₹299, which is below the minimum starting price of ₹599 for Jeans/Denim set by AF-004, constituting a factual inaccuracy.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase the advertised price to at least ₹599, e.g., "Grab these pre‑loved denim jeans for only ₹599!"
